verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यथासंप्रत्ययं कविः। विदुरः प्रेषयामास तद्वनं पुरुषं शुचिम्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : In the meanwhile, the learned Vidura sent to that forest a man of pure character whom he much trusted.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा तु यथोद्देशं पाण्डवान्ददृशे वने। जनन्या सह कौरव्यमापयानान्नदीजलम्॥२॥
verses.english: He went to the place where he was directed to go; and he was the descendants of Kuru, the son of Pandu, with their mother, measuring the depth of the water of a river in the forest.
verses.bhavadeepa: ऊनपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः एतस्मिन्निति । यथासंप्रत्ययं यथासङ्केतं शुचिं नाचिकम् । मापयानान् जलपरिमाणं परीक्षमाणान् ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: विदितं तन्महाबुद्धेर्विदुरस्य महात्मनः। ततस्तस्यापि चारेण चेष्टितं पापचेतसः॥३॥
verses.english: The design of the wicked minded (Duryodhana) was made kncwn by this spy to the high souled and greatly learned Vidura. Therefore that learned man was sent by Vidura and that person showed to the sons of Pritha a boat, as swift as mind or wind. With mechanism and flags, made by trusted artificers and capable of withstanding wind and waves. It was on the banks of the holy Bhagirathi.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवासितो विद्वान्विदुरेण नरस्तदा। पार्थानां दर्शयामास मनो मारुतगामिनीम्॥४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य चेष्टितं चारेण विदुरस्य विदितं यतस्ततो हेतोः विदुरेण ततः स्वस्थानात् नरः प्रवासितः प्रेषित इति सार्धश्लोको वाक्यम् ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववातसहां नावं यन्त्रयुक्तां पताकिनीम्। शिवे भागीरथीतीरे नरैर्विस्रम्भिभिः कृतान्॥५॥
ततः पुनरथोवाच ज्ञापकं पूर्वचोदितम्। युधिष्ठिर निबोधेदं संज्ञार्थं वचनं कवेः॥६॥
verses.english: He said these word to show that he was really sent (by Vidura). (He said), "O Yudhishthira, listen to what the learned Vidura) said to you.

verses.sanskrit: कक्षघ्नः शिशिरघ्नश्च महाकक्षे बिलौकसः। न हन्तीत्येवमात्मानं यो रक्षति स जीवति॥७॥
verses.english: He lives who protects himself by the knowledge that neither the consumer of straw and wood not the drier of dews burns the inmates of a hole in the deep forest.

verses.sanskrit: तेन मां प्रेषितं विद्धि विश्वस्तं संज्ञयाऽनया। भूयश्चैवाह मां क्षत्ता विदुरः सर्वतोऽर्थवित्॥८॥
verses.english: By these credentials know me to have been sent by Vidura and also to be his trusted agent. Kshatta (Vidura), learned in the precepts of all religions, told me also. O son of Kunti, that you shall surely defeat in battle Karna, Duryodhana with his brothers and Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णं दुर्योधनं चैव भ्रातृभिः सहितं रणे। शकुनिं चैव कौन्तेय विजेताऽसि न संशयः॥९॥
इयं वारिपथे युक्ता नौरप्सु सुखगामिनी। मोचयिष्यति वः सर्वानस्माद्देशान्न संशयः॥१०॥
verses.english: "This boat is ready on the waters. It will glide pleasantly on. It will surely carry away from these regions."

verses.sanskrit: अथ तान्व्यथितान्दृष्ट्वा सह मात्रा नरोत्तमान्। नावमारोप्य गङ्गायां प्रस्थितानब्रवीत्पुनः॥११॥
verses.english: Seeing those best of men with their mother pensive and sad, he made them get on the boat that was on the Ganges. Going with them hiniself, he again said ..

verses.sanskrit: विदुरो मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य वचो मुहुः। अरिष्टं गच्छता व्यग्राः पन्थानमिति चाब्रवीत्॥१२॥
verses.english: "Vidura, having smelled your heads and embracing you, has said it again and again that in commencing your auspicious journey and going alone, you should never be careless."

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा स तु तान्वीरान्पुमान्विदुरचोदितः। तारयामास राजेन्द्र गङ्गां नावा नरर्षभान्॥१३॥
verses.english: O king, having said this, the man sent by Vidura took those heroes, those best of man, to the other side of the Ganges on his boat.

verses.sanskrit: तारयित्वा ततो गङ्गां पारं प्राप्तांश्च सर्वशः। जयाशिषः प्रयुज्याथ यथागतमगाद्धि सः॥१४॥
verses.english: Having taken them over the waters and seen them all safe on the opposite bank, he uttered the word Jaya (Victory) and blessing them he went back to the place whence he came.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवाश्च महात्मानः प्रतिसन्दिश्य वै कवेः। गङ्गामुत्तीर्य वेगेन जग्मुर्गूढमलक्षिताः॥१५॥
verses.english: The illustrious Pandavas also, sending some message to the learned (Vidura) and having crossed the Ganges, proceeded in haste and in great secrecy, being your observed by all.
